name: smwmusic-dragon-quest-iii-fighting-spirit
title: Dragon Quest III - Fighting Spirit
description:
Requested by isaix.
The wild and energetic battle theme from Dragon Quest III for the SNES. Useful for boss battles and other tense/hectic scenarios.

IMPORTANT:
Given the large size of the samples, I've provided an option ("reduceEchoDelay") you can toggle.
0 - The song will use the original echo delay, but it will be incompatible with Bonus End, Yoshi, P-Switch, Starman and Thunder.
1 - The song will use a reduced echo delay, lowering the quality, but making it usable with all vanilla songs and SFX.
